brief.headline: MPENERGI AS
brief.summary: MPENERGI AS (organisation number 916574347) is a private limited company in annen spesialisert bygge- og anleggsvirksomhet ikke nevnt annet sted (NACE 43.990), founded in 2015, with its registered business address in Oslo. On its verified website the company describes itself as: "mpenergi er et konsulent firma primært mot fornybar energi, infrastruktur, klima og miljø for industrielle / kommersielle aktører. mpenergi ble etablert i 1997 og til konsulentselskap fra 2015. mpenergi AS eies av vårt aksjeselskap i EU .mpenergi utfører arbeid over hele Europa gjennom…". Leadership on the register: Morten Pedersen (chief executive and chair of the board). Scale: 1 registered workplace in Oslo. In its filed accounts for 2025, the company reported revenue of 2.6 m NOK, an operating result of 267,302 NOK and a net result of 274,086 NOK; calculated from those figures, that is an operating margin of 10.1% and an equity ratio of 85%. Filed company revenue was 2.6 m NOK in 2025, up 919,421 NOK (53.5%) from 1.7 m NOK in 2024. Online, it has a verified website at https://mp-energi.no/ and company-owned profiles on Facebook and X. It can be contacted by email at mort-p@online.no and by phone on +47 27042027. Recent public activity: 7 dated items; the latest on 2026-10-07 was "Energi – og infrastruktur prosjekt". This is the first observation of the company, so no changes are reported yet. Not established from permitted sources: an employee count, whether it is hiring and independent news coverage.
